boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named Canisius study environments, from reservable library rooms to focused campus lounges.

cards.title: Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Andrew L. Bouwhuis, SJ, Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room through the library’s study-room process, then plan your session within regular library operating hours.
cards.short_summary: A reservable option for focused individual or small-group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius lists 12 library study rooms that students may reserve during regular library operating hours.
cards.access_notes: Student reservations; available during regular library operating hours.

cards.title: Study Center
cards.subtitle: Old Main 311
cards.notes: Bring the materials for the assignment you want to complete, swipe in with your Canisius ID, and use the quiet work setting.
cards.short_summary: A supervised quiet study room near tutoring services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Study Center is in Old Main 311, is open to all Canisius students, and provides a quiet environment for academic work.
cards.access_notes: Canisius ID card required; posted hours are Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–9 p.m., Friday 9 a.m.–4 p.m., and Sunday noon–9 p.m.

cards.title: Bouwhuis Library Lower-Level Quiet Floor
cards.subtitle: Andrew L. Bouwhuis, SJ, Library
cards.notes: Choose the lower level when you need a deliberately peaceful setting, and pair the session with Writing Center support nearby.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet floor in the university library.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius identifies the lower level of Bouwhuis Library as its designated quiet floor and notes that the Writing Center is located there temporarily.
cards.access_notes: Located on the library lower level; check library access before visiting.

cards.title: Golisano Center Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Andrew L. Bouwhuis, SJ, Library
cards.notes: Use a blue-and-gold study pod for individual work or a small collaboration, then connect with nearby academic support services.
cards.short_summary: Quiet pods within the new student-success hub.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius says the Golisano Center’s study pods provide quiet, focused space for individual work and small-group collaboration.
cards.source_title: Canisius Celebrates Opening of the Golisano Center for Student Success
cards.access_notes: Public areas follow regular library hours; the Golisano Center follows regular school business hours.

cards.title: Science Hall Commons
cards.subtitle: Science Hall
cards.notes: Set up during the daytime study window; move to another space after 4 p.m. when the Commons may be used for events.
cards.short_summary: A daytime common-area study option in Science Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius lists Science Hall Commons as a study location available from 8:30 a.m. to 4 p.m., after which it is used for event space.
cards.access_notes: Available for study 8:30 a.m.–4 p.m.; the space is used for events after 4 p.m.

cards.title: Science Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: Science Hall
cards.notes: Use the atrium as an open-campus setting for reading, laptop work, or a short work block between classes.
cards.short_summary: An atrium listed by Canisius among campus study locations.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius lists the Science Hall Atrium among additional places for students to study on campus.
cards.access_notes: Campus study location; confirm building access when planning an evening visit.

cards.title: Health Science Building Lounges
cards.subtitle: Health Science Building
cards.notes: Look for an available lounge seat in the Health Science Building when you need an informal place to review notes or read.
cards.short_summary: Lounge areas included on Canisius’ campus-study list.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius lists the Health Science Building Lounges among additional places for students to study on campus.
cards.access_notes: Campus study location; confirm building access when planning a visit.

cards.title: Old Main 2nd–4th Floor Lounges
cards.subtitle: Old Main
cards.notes: Check the second through fourth floors for an available lounge area, then choose the floor that fits your class schedule.
cards.short_summary: Three floors of Old Main lounges identified for campus study.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius lists lounges on the second through fourth floors of Old Main as additional places for students to study.
cards.access_notes: Campus study location; confirm Old Main building access before visiting.

cards.title: Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student Center, lower level
cards.notes: If you are eligible to use the commuter space, bring a compact task and settle into the Student Center’s lower-level lounge.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level Student Center lounge on Canisius’ study-space list.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius lists the Commuter Lounge on the lower level of the Student Center as an additional place to study.
cards.access_notes: Located on the Student Center lower level; access may be intended for commuter students.

cards.title: Veteran’s Resource Center
cards.subtitle: Old Main 320
cards.notes: Eligible students can use this Old Main resource setting for a focused work block; verify access with the center before relying on it.
cards.short_summary: A named Old Main resource center listed as a study option.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius lists the Veteran’s Resource Center in Old Main 320 among additional places for students to study on campus.
cards.access_notes: Located in Old Main 320; confirm eligibility and access with the Veteran’s Resource Center.
